content: We use a pre-trained 300-dimensional word embedding, GloVe, by BIBREF10 . We apply random search to the hyperparameter tuning of the LSTM language model. The best hyperparameters are as follows: 2 hidden layers each with 300 units, a sequence length of 35, a learning rate of 20 with an annealing schedule of decay starting from 0.25 to 0.95, a dropout rate of 0.25 and a gradient clip of 0.25. We train our models for 150 epochs, use a batch size of 48, and set early stopping with a patience of 5.
